D.t: Hank Johnson leads by 71.4 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 238,855 votes; a one point swing is about 1,673 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +63.8 and D +78.1. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
